sentence_1_it: La messa è una cerimonia cattolica per ricordare Gesù Cristo mangiando e bevendo.
sentence_1_en: Mass is a Catholic ceremony of remembering Jesus Christ by eating and drinking.
sentence_2_it: Fervono i preparativi per la cerimonia.
sentence_2_en: Preparations for the ceremony are under way.
sentence_3_it: Alla cerimonia di inaugurazione fu scoperta una targa in onore del fondatore.
sentence_3_en: At the inauguration ceremony a plaque was unveiled in honor of the founder.
